entries.en: Por dios, these kids don't know shit...
entries.ro: Por dios, copiii ăștia nu știu un căcat...

entries.en: <mothertongue l="mex" m="chavos de la calle" b="Yeah, not like the " a=" – ain't no better school than the streets."/>
entries.ro: <mothertongue l="mex" m="chavos de la calle" b="Da, nu ca " a=" – nu e școală mai bună decât strada."/>

entries.en: <mothertongue l="mex" m="Pinches chavos..." b="" a=" They come to me – the baddest <Rich color=\"MainColors.ActiveBlue\">cabrón</> on the block – for free samples? Free?! Where the fuck they get that idea from, eh?"/>
entries.ro: <mothertongue l="mex" m="Pinches chavos..." b="" a=" Ei vin la mine – cel mai tare <Rich color=\"MainColors.ActiveBlue\">cabrón</> de pe stradă – pentru mostre gratis? Gratis?! De unde pula mea au ideea asta, eh?"/>

entries.en: <mothertongue l="mex" m="Sí" b="" a=", or the media."/>
entries.ro: <mothertongue l="mex" m="Sí" b="" a=", sau din media."/>

entries.en: There is no such thing as "free" in this life.
entries.ro: Gratis nu există în viața asta.

entries.en: Ey, man, you preachin' to the converted.
